answer: An operator's vault runs one echo queue and accepts one judged epoch at a time; each epoch credits one non-transferable jade, and admitting the kth identity spends k jade, so ten identities spend 55 jade earned over 55 sequential judged epochs while a solo identity spends one. The vault signs every epoch's echo into one head, and a successor vault must present that head, so clones cannot farm judged work in parallel, split the queue, or restart on a fresh vault.
